description: Three board states reuse a board and queen, then hide a failed placement.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200"><defs><g id="board"><rect x="20" y="48" width="96" height="96" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)"/><line x1="68" y1="48" x2="68" y2="144" stroke="var(--hairline)"/><line x1="20" y1="96" x2="116" y2="96" stroke="var(--hairline)"/></g><g id="queen"><circle cx="44" cy="72" r="9" fill="var(--voice)"/></g></defs><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16" font-family="var(--font-voice)">Try, then undo</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Place one queen."><use href="#board"/><use href="#queen"/></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="Try a second queen."><use href="#queen" x="48" y="48"/><text x="140" y="80" font-size="12">A trial</text></g><g data-step="3" data-hide="2" data-caption="Undo the trial; one queen remains."><text x="140" y="110" font-size="12">One remains</text></g></svg>

description: A call tree hides an unknown value when the base case returns.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Return from a leaf</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Split the call into two children."><text x="140" y="54" font-size="12">f(2)</text><line x1="150" y1="65" x2="80" y2="102" stroke="var(--ink)"/><line x1="160" y1="65" x2="235" y2="102" stroke="var(--ink)"/><text x="55" y="125" font-size="12">f(1)</text><text x="220" y="125" font-size="12">f(0)</text></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="The first result is unknown."><text x="60" y="155" font-size="12">?</text></g><g data-step="3" data-hide="2" data-caption="The base case returns one."><text x="60" y="155" font-size="12">= 1</text></g></svg>

description: A narrow flow branches from a decision to two outcomes.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 220"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Check the result</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Compare the stored value."><rect x="90" y="45" width="140" height="34" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)"/><text x="110" y="67" font-size="12">Match?</text></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="Choose the matching branch."><polyline points="130,79 130,110 60,110 60,145" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)"/><polyline points="190,79 190,110 260,110 260,145" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)"/><text x="35" y="170" font-size="12">Accept</text><text x="235" y="170" font-size="12">Reject</text></g></svg>

description: A curve has two marked sample points beside its axes.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 230"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">A rising curve</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Read horizontal position and height."><polyline points="40,48 40,190 280,190" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)"/><text x="287" y="195" font-size="12">x</text><text x="20" y="52" font-size="12">y</text></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="Two points lie on the curve."><path d="M 60 170 Q 140 160 250 65" fill="none" stroke="var(--voice)"/><circle cx="60" cy="170" r="3" fill="var(--voice)"/><circle cx="250" cy="65" r="3" fill="var(--voice)"/><text x="68" y="148" font-size="12">A</text><text x="260" y="56" font-size="12">B</text></g></svg>

description: Two force arrows leave a small body, with labels well beside the shafts.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 220"><defs><marker id="tip" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 5 3 L 0 6" fill="none" stroke="var(--voice)"/></marker></defs><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Balance the forces</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Represent the body as a small box."><rect x="135" y="100" width="30" height="30" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/><text x="190" y="120" font-size="12">Body</text></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="The arrows show upward support and downward weight."><line x1="150" y1="100" x2="150" y2="50" marker-end="url(#tip)" stroke="var(--voice)"/><line x1="150" y1="130" x2="150" y2="190" marker-end="url(#tip)" stroke="var(--voice)"/><text x="170" y="63" font-size="12">Support</text><text x="170" y="185" font-size="12">Weight</text></g></svg>

description: A molecule skeleton is vertical so right-hand labels have space.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 240"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Read down the chain</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="The skeleton runs vertically."><line x1="65" y1="60" x2="65" y2="180" stroke="var(--ink)"/><circle cx="65" cy="60" r="5" fill="var(--voice)"/><circle cx="65" cy="120" r="5" fill="var(--voice)"/><circle cx="65" cy="180" r="5" fill="var(--voice)"/></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="Labels identify each site on the right."><text x="90" y="64" font-size="12">C — tetrahedral</text><text x="90" y="124" font-size="12">N — lone pair</text><text x="90" y="184" font-size="12">O — terminal</text></g></svg>

description: Rows of orbital boxes with pointer arrows leave room for labels.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200"><defs><marker id="tip" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" refX="5" refY="3" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 5 3 L 0 6" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/></marker></defs><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Fill one at a time</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Three boxes form a row."><rect x="40" y="65" width="40" height="40" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/><rect x="105" y="65" width="40" height="40" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/><rect x="170" y="65" width="40" height="40" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="Each arrow occupies a different box."><line x1="60" y1="96" x2="60" y2="74" stroke="var(--voice)" marker-end="url(#tip)"/><line x1="125" y1="96" x2="125" y2="74" stroke="var(--voice)" marker-end="url(#tip)"/><text x="40" y="140" font-size="12">Separate before pairing</text></g></svg>

description: Three events on a timeline have alternating labels with clear spacing.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Events in order</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Time advances left to right."><line x1="25" y1="95" x2="285" y2="95" stroke="var(--ink)"/><circle cx="50" cy="95" r="4" fill="var(--voice)"/><text x="25" y="68" font-size="12">Start</text></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="A review precedes the final release."><circle cx="150" cy="95" r="4" fill="var(--voice)"/><circle cx="255" cy="95" r="4" fill="var(--voice)"/><text x="125" y="132" font-size="12">Review</text><text x="230" y="68" font-size="12">Release</text></g></svg>

description: A number line locates zero and a positive displacement.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 160"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Move from zero</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Zero divides the number line."><line x1="25" y1="90" x2="285" y2="90" stroke="var(--ink)"/><line x1="100" y1="84" x2="100" y2="96" stroke="var(--ink)"/><text x="96" y="120" font-size="12">0</text></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="The point is three units to the right."><circle cx="220" cy="90" r="4" fill="var(--voice)"/><text x="216" y="120" font-size="12">3</text></g></svg>

description: Two separate panels compare a fragmented state with a joined state.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 190"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">A state change</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Before: two separate pieces."><text x="25" y="60" font-size="12">Before</text><rect x="25" y="85" width="30" height="35" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/><rect x="80" y="85" width="30" height="35" stroke="var(--ink)" fill="none"/></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="After: the pieces form one block."><text x="190" y="60" font-size="12">After</text><rect x="190" y="85" width="60" height="35" stroke="var(--voice)" fill="var(--wash)"/></g></svg>

description: A sequence between three actors uses spaced lifelines and side labels.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 250"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">One request</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Three actors participate."><text x="20" y="55" font-size="12">Client</text><text x="120" y="55" font-size="12">Server</text><text x="235" y="55" font-size="12">Store</text><line x1="45" y1="70" x2="45" y2="220" stroke="var(--hairline)"/><line x1="150" y1="70" x2="150" y2="220" stroke="var(--hairline)"/><line x1="260" y1="70" x2="260" y2="220" stroke="var(--hairline)"/></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="The client asks; the server reads."><line x1="45" y1="115" x2="150" y2="115" stroke="var(--voice)"/><text x="65" y="100" font-size="12">Ask</text><line x1="150" y1="175" x2="260" y2="175" stroke="var(--voice)"/><text x="180" y="160" font-size="12">Read</text></g></svg>

description: A small table compares two cases with row labels and no crowded grid.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 210"><text x="18" y="24" font-size="16">Compare the cases</text><g data-step="1" data-caption="Each column has a distinct meaning."><text x="25" y="60" font-size="12">Case</text><text x="170" y="60" font-size="12">Result</text><line x1="20" y1="75" x2="290" y2="75" stroke="var(--hairline)"/></g><g data-step="2" data-caption="Read one case per row."><text x="25" y="108" font-size="12">Valid</text><text x="170" y="108" font-size="12">Accept</text><text x="25" y="150" font-size="12">Invalid</text><text x="170" y="150" font-size="12">Reject</text></g></svg>
